name: Waveshare ESP32-C6-Touch-AMOLED-1.32
description: 1.32" 466x466 round AMOLED (CO5300, QSPI), CST820 touch, ES8311 speaker and microphone, battery sense.
verify: Pins from Waveshare's demo code and schematic (https://github.com/waveshareteam/ESP32-C6-Touch-AMOLED-1.32). No pin differs between the vendor's code and the schematic's wiring. What disagrees is inside each source: 1) Battery divider. Example/Arduino/04_BATT_PWR_Test/src/vbat_bsp/vbat_bsp.cpp has 'vol = 0.001 * tage * 2' (the ESP32-S3 board's file, unchanged), while 01_ADC_Test/adc_bsp.cpp and the ESP-IDF vbat_bsp.cpp have '* 3'. The schematic's R7 200K over R9 100K makes it 3: believed. Waveshare runs this glass under orientation byte 0xC0 with the picture starting at column 6, and the preset does the same: the byte is on the Display tab, and a turned design is turned over it. Brightness is a command to the panel, not a backlight pin. Compiled; not run on a board here.
